description: The group holding a finding: its primary finding (where the fix belongs), the other findings Odin or a person grouped with it as duplicates or one root cause, and whether a person tracked it as one or Odin detected or only suggested it. Null when the finding is on its own. Requires read permission.

findingId.description: The finding's findingId (not an identifier such as ODI-12), from list_findings or get_finding.

name: get_finding_group
title: Get a finding's group
